data.long_meaning: Rashidah is an Islamic baby name for girls. It means rightly guided, correct in judgment and action, leading in the right path. The name Rashidah carries the meaning “Rightly Guided” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Rashidah usually hope their child will grow to embody rightly guided and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with a spiritual connotation, Rashidah is a reminder for the bearer to always seek guidance from Allah and to strive to lead a life that is in accordance with the teachings of Islam.
data.etymology: Rashidah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rightly Guided.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rashidah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rashidah can be considered as a symbol of guidance, as it was the name of the fourth caliph of Islam, Caliph Ali Zain Al-Abidin, who is known for his deep understanding of religious laws and his righteous ruling over the Islamic community, especially during difficult times. Moreover, the name Rose, which is a common nickname for Rashidah, is one that is commonly used to describe someone who is charming and refreshing. In some Middle Eastern communities, girls named Rashidah are seen as elite, beautiful and graceful.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Rashidah holds deep spiritual significance as it signifies being led on the right path by Allah SWT with wisdom, understanding and guidance. Being rightly-guided also means striving for self-improvement and adhering to the teachings of Islam in every aspect of life. It is a name of hope and strength, reminding one to stay aligned with their faith and seek Allah's guidance to navigate through life's challenges.
